author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇵🇸 Drake just premiered a new song and says "Pray for Gaza"

For those who don't know, Drake is half Jewish, but has publicly voiced his support for Palestine in the past. Most notably, he was one of the first major artist to sign a letter to Biden, 23 days after Oct 7th, calling for an immediate ceasefire and humanitarian aid into Gaza. 

He also called out DJ Khaled for staying silent. Both of Khaled's parents were born in Palestine.

Writer: Daniel
